from pysat.solvers import Glucose4
import itertools

n = 21
edges = list(itertools.combinations(range(n), 2))
edge_to_var = {e: i+1 for i, e in enumerate(edges)}

solver = Glucose4()

# No red K_4 (color 0) -> at least one edge must be 1 (True)
for clique in itertools.combinations(range(n), 4):
    clause = [edge_to_var[e] for e in itertools.combinations(clique, 2)]
    solver.add_clause(clause)

# No blue K_5 (color 1) -> at least one edge must be 0 (False)
for clique in itertools.combinations(range(n), 5):
    clause = [-edge_to_var[e] for e in itertools.combinations(clique, 2)]
    solver.add_clause(clause)

if solver.solve():
    model = solver.get_model()
    solution = [1 if model[i] > 0 else 0 for i in range(len(edges))]
    print("SAT")
    print(solution)
else:
    print("UNSAT")
